The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

title: A Second Chance Christmas
overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

title: Love Lottery
overview: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

title: Isla
overview: Lusted after by all, she trades her innocence to escape her island. Betrayed, she strips away her abusers' darkest secrets in this sultry cinematic classic.

title: The Lost Children of Tuam
overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

title: The Night Marchers
overview: Twenty-five years ago, a documentary crew vanished in Hawaii's deepest valleys while hunting the legendary Night Marchers. Now, their recovered footage shows the horrifying truth about an ancient Hawaiian legend best left alone.

title: Hinotama: Ball of Fire
overview: As his parents' marriage fractures and eventually collapses into divorce, high schooler Takeshi becomes increasingly obsessed with hunting for a mysterious 'ball of fire' rumored by a childhood friend. Using this quest to escape the quiet turmoil at home, Takeshi leaves his younger brother to shoulder the family's emotional weight without realizing it.

title: The Sixth Sense
overview: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.

title: Dhoomakethu
overview: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

title: Family
overview: A 10-year-old girl begins to believe her parents are trying to kill her. Convinced a sinister spirit is to blame, she spirals into a haunting fantasy world that mirrors her deepest fears.

title: The Haunted Town
overview: The film tells the story of a century-old legend surrounding the Wangjiaji Fox Temple. A series of bizarre and gruesome cases erupts one after another, with several townspeople meeting mysterious and horrifying deaths.

title: Our Share of Sand
overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

title: Black Church Bay
overview: In a sleepy Welsh fishing village, Barry’s life starts to unravel after an intimate encounter with a younger man.

title: Things I Left at the Theater
overview: Film critic Dogyeong belatedly learns of an old friend's death. As it happens, this comes not long after the demolition of an old theater in Gangwon Province. Somehow, the two events do not feel all that different to her. As her work as a critic takes her from place to place, Dogyeong searches for her late friend’s short film and visits theaters and screening spaces where it might once have been shown.

title: Shumei: The Living Legacy of Kabuki
overview: A look at the succession ceremony in which Ichikawa Danjūrō XIII formally inherited the storied Danjūrō name in Kabuki, Japan’s classical performing art. The film records the behind-the-scenes preparations for the actor’s name-inheritance debut performance.

title: 100 Days
overview: "100 Days" is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: Nagi Notes
overview: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.

title: A Ballad of Longing
original_title: ดวงอุราลำหา
overview: After the sudden death of a troupe’s lead molam actress, Biw is chosen as her temporary replacement. As the troupe heads to the capital, she must leave behind her bedridden mother and choose between her dream and her family.

title: Девочки учатся бриться
overview: The late 1990s. Best friends Misha and Taya dream of escaping the small coastal town where adults have long since decided what their future should be. The brash Misha falls in love with a new teacher, while the quiet Taya hides the fact that her parents are planning to marry her off to a foreigner to save the family. Their friendship, through betrayal and pain, becomes a pillar of strength: they understand that growing up doesn't mean running away, but rather learning to stand up for yourself, even if it means being hurt by reality.

title: Acharya
overview: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.

title: Charlie Harper
overview: The journey of two young souls, Charlie and Harper, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

title: Papaya
overview: Passionate about flying, a tiny papaya seed in the Amazonian forest must keep moving to avoid rooting. Through perseverance, she discovers the power of her roots, triggering a revolution that transforms her world and fulfills her dreams in an unexpected way.

title: Ut Lan 2
overview: Since the appearance of a two-headed snake, a riverside village is plagued by a series of mysterious deaths. As long-forgotten secrets slowly rise to the surface, the villagers realize that some curses never truly disappear.

title: The Paradise
overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

title: (Failing to Make) A Documentary About My Sudanese Family
original_title: (Failing to Make) A Documentary About My Sudanese Family
overview: A filmmaker sets out to document a trip with his family in the shadow of a civil war, but finds the process undoing the film itself.

title: Justin the Just
overview: France, World War I. Justin (Alban Ivanov), an illiterate peasant farmer is enrolled in French army. Knowing nothing of the World or the War, Justin finds himself on the front without understanding why he must kill men he’s never met. Naïve and open minded, Justin will cross the path of a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, escape a prisoner camp and start a mutiny to prevent his fellow comrades to risk their lives. Through his journey Justin will question the absurdity of war, make lifetime friends and inspire many…

title: Kangoroo Returns
overview: After a glowing sports career in England, famed footaball player Kangoroo returns to Belgrade, alongside his fiancée Elektra. But, the times have changed and the city he grew up may not be ready for the vision he brings with him.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: National Theatre Live: The Misanthrope
overview: Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the hollow contemporary mantras of kindness and respect. But the bolder she becomes in speaking out, the more colleagues avoid her, and the more her personal relationships begin to fracture. As she challenges fashionable ideas and lends her voice to causes others are afraid to touch, she faces intense criticism and backlash. Alice will soon learn the price she must pay as an artist and as a woman for daring to speak her mind. Award-winner Sandra Oh is the Misanthrope in Martin Crimp's cutting new version of Molière's dark comedy, directed by National Theatre Director Indhu Rubasingham.

title: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
overview: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: Concessions
overview: As the Royal Alamo Cinema closes its doors for good, jaded staff, eccentric patrons, and an unhinged manager stumble through one last night at the movies—grappling with busted dreams, bad popcorn, and hard goodbyes.

title: Grotesca
overview: Camila is a young woman tormented by cannibalistic thoughts. When one day her partner, Victoria, volunteers to satisfy that need, Camila is torn by an internal conflict that, in the days that follow, will make her oscillate between desire, love, and guilt, confronting the emotional roots of her compulsion in search of a decision.

title: La Joconde : le mystère de Mona Lisa
original_title: La Joconde : le mystère de Mona Lisa

title: The Lion King
overview: Young lion prince Simba, eager to one day become king of the Pride Lands, grows up under the watchful eye of his father Mufasa; all the while his villainous uncle Scar conspires to take the throne for himself. Amid betrayal and tragedy, Simba must confront his past and find his rightful place in the Circle of Life.

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, Christophe (10) tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: Zustìssia
overview: Set among the mountains of southern Sardinia, Zustissia reconstructs the 1991 triple homicide that led to Zuncheddu being sentenced to life imprisonment. He spent 33 years in prison before being definitively acquitted on 26 January 2024, following a retrial initiated by lawyer Mauro Trogu.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
overview: Captain Jack Sparrow’s got a blood debt to pay: he owes his soul to the legendary Davy Jones, ghastly Ruler of the Ocean Depths. To escape eternal servitude aboard the Flying Dutchman, ever-crafty Jack must track down the still-beating heart of Jones. But he won’t do it alone: Will Turner and Elizabeth Swann are drawn back into another one of his perilous quests—assuming they can evade execution for aiding a pirate.

title: Social Media Killed the Movie Star
original_title: Social Media Killed the Movie Star

title: Parallel Consequences
overview: Max and his friends, Pedro and Bruna, discover a time machine and decide to test it. What begins as an adventure quickly turns into a nightmare when Pedro inexplicably tries to kill Max, who must repeatedly travel back a few seconds in time to survive and uncover the truth. Caught in an unstable timeline, the three friends confront dark truths about themselves, the weight of their choices, and the unpredictable consequences of trying to rewrite destiny.

title: Frost
overview: A rational, and emotionally distant female police detective investigates the disappearance of a girl in a region famous for black magic and pagan heritage. Her investigation gradually becomes a journey into a mythical world.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: “湾区升明月”2026大湾区电影音乐晚会
original_title: “湾区升明月”2026大湾区电影音乐晚会

title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
overview: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku is the much-awaited sequel to the 2024 all-time blockbuster Bohurupi, where Bikram and Jhimli return, stepping into a thrilling new chapter of adventure and high-stakes drama.

title: Heaven in Stone and Glass
overview: On April 15, 2019, the world watched in horror as flames erupted from the rafters of Notre-Dame Cathedral – an event that captivated global audiences and ignited an overwhelming response of loss, awe, and shared cultural grief. Why did the threat to this sacred space resonate so deeply, even among those with no religious affiliation? Bishop Robert Barron returns to France to answer this question, taking the viewer on a cinematic pilgrimage.

title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
overview: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
original_title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
overview: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

title: Seriously Single Too
overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

title: Therapy Done Right
overview: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

title: Clean Hands
overview: The true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis and "the thin blue line" from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

title: Mellan Himmel och Körtburkar
overview: A feature film by the comedy group Småstadsliv, featuring recurring personalities from their universe. The plot revolves around hilarious and zany events—imbued with true small-town spirit and featuring colorful characters—including the debut of the character Sari as a psychopath.

title: The Revenant
overview: In the 1820s, a frontiersman, Hugh Glass, sets out on a path of vengeance against those who left him for dead after a bear mauling.

title: Spainter
overview: In the midst of war, a color pencil found on the battlefield awakens a sniper’s forgotten childhood passion for painting, forcing him to confront the violence that erased it.

title: See Me
overview: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

title: Jupiter
overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

title: Guarding Stars
overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

title: Agnes & Amir
original_title: Lieblingsmenschen - Die außergewöhnliche Freundschaft von Agnes & Amir
overview: Amir is 28, gay and has just fled from Iran. Agnes is 101 and still too young for a retirement home - she thinks. The two move in together - and save each other's lives.

title: Canned Heat
overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

title: Inherit
original_title: คุณยายวรนาฏ
overview: A prominent, affluent family's meticulously engineered public facade systematically implodes when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their genetic bloodline, violently exposing deep-seated ancestral anomalies and transgressive secrets.

title: Dark Horse
overview: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

title: Troy
overview: In year 1250 B.C. during the late Bronze age, two emerging nations begin to clash. Paris, the Trojan prince, convinces Helen, Queen of Sparta, to leave her husband Menelaus, and sail with him back to Troy. After Menelaus finds out that his wife was taken by the Trojans, he asks his brother Agamemnon to help him get her back. Agamemnon sees this as an opportunity for power. They set off with 1,000 ships holding 50,000 Greeks to Troy.

title: El mal padre
overview: After years of estrangement, the famous writer and academic Santiago Balmes gathers his three children for a last request: to spend Christmas in the house where they used to spend summers as kids.

title: November 1963
overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

title: The Rainbow Fish
overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.

title: Electric Mushrooms
overview: As the Cheshire Cat once said: Imagination is the only weapon in the war against reality. This is Electric Mushrooms...

title: The Airport Chaplain
overview: At a bustling international airport, lost people seek missed connections, while others carry heavy personal baggage. Tobias Wallace shepherds them all. Scruffy and benevolent in his hi-vis “Chaplain”-printed vest and always on call, he’ll bend rules to help passengers and workers alike – that includes Asha, a young woman hiding in the prayer room whose murky history stirs Tobias’s own deeply buried traumas. Not everybody is a fan of his methods, however: ambitious new terminal manager Mira has liability nightmare Tobias marked for redundancy. But as crises appear everywhere – overworked baggage handlers, security breaches, families torn apart and grief-stricken relatives – maybe this infuriating chaplain could be Mira’s salvation.

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

title: Best Pancakes in the County
overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own. As loyalties blur and tensions erupt, survival depends on who can outthink – and outgun – everyone else. In this diner, the 'best pancakes in the county' turn out to be the least explosive thing on the menu.

title: The Widower
overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

title: D23 Horizons: Disney Experiences Showcase
overview: Join host Neil Patrick Harris for a journey into the stories shaping the future of Disney Experiences around the world at “D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event.” Building on the ambitious projects announced in 2024, this showcase takes fans deeper into the creative vision behind what’s to come, hearing directly from the Imagineers, storytellers, artists, and innovators bringing these experiences to life. Inspired by the Carousel of Progress, Harris guides engaging conversations, behind-the-scenes looks, special performances, exciting announcements, and a few surprises along the way.

title: Haplos Ni Milagros
overview: VMX Star Vern Kaye takes on a bold new role as Milagros, a young beautiful faith healer who uses her healing hands to cure Erwin’s problem with his manhood. But when she falls for him, her powers begin to fade. Will she choose love or her gift to heal?

title: Hushar Pittalu
overview: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
original_title: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich
overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: Magudam
overview: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

title: All Night Wrong
overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: User Not Found
overview: Two men and women with unknown identities, a live online trial in a confined space, and an extreme escape between death and truth

title: This, That, and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: Agadha
overview: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

title: Perumahan Laddaland
overview: A devoted father’s dream of providing a better life for his family turns into a living nightmare when their newly purchased suburban home becomes the target of escalating supernatural terror and dark neighborhood secrets.

title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit - Extended Movie Cut
original_title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit - Extended Movie Cut
overview: Join the Doctor and Rose as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.

title: Drift
overview: Over the course of a single night, a convoy of cars carries intimate conversations on the representation of Black bodies in France.

title: Yo, Narciso
overview: Rocío Flores is a sociologist writing a book about modern narcissism. For her investigation, she acts as the patient of Máximo Rey, a charismatic and egocentric plastic surgeon, triggering a series of hilarious scenarios.

title: Leave This Room Buried
overview: A poetic personal journey through the director's memories of the past and present, presented through unconventional combinations of images and sounds and the haunting presence of silence that threatens to whisk them away into the oblivion.

title: Un grand raccourci
overview: When their family restaurant is on the verge of closing, two cousins release rats in an attempt to set themselves up as pest control experts. That same summer, two young women rig the local beauty contest to promote their jewelry. Caught up in their chaotic schemes, these four resourceful young people searching for a better future eventually cross paths.

title: Curse of the Shark
overview: When a marine biology team explore unusual shark activity in Central America, they discover the horrifying truth behind an island legend.

title: Way of the Warrior Kid
overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

title: M.I.S.S.I.O.N. Opera Undercover Agent
original_title: M.I.S.S.I.O.N. 歌劇な潜入捜査官
overview: Matsumi Kanata, a brilliant but antisocial Tokyo police detective, is tasked with a secret mission: infiltrate Tsubakino University of the Arts to identify the culprit behind a series of drone bombings. Because the institution was recently an all-women's university and remains predominantly female, Kanata is forced to disguise himself as a woman to blend in.  During his undercover assignment, he crosses paths with three distinct students: Haruna, the vocal department's star performer; Misuzu, who grows hostile after losing a musical role to Kanata; and Riko, who discovers his true identity but becomes his investigative partner.  As Kanata immerses himself in student life, he gets so swept up in rehearsals for the upcoming musical production that he begins neglecting his mission. Everything comes to a head on the day of the performance when a sudden dramatic turn forces Kanata to balance saving the musical with finally uncovering the bomber's true identity.

title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney
overview: Via archival footage and a vintage yet unserious style, this is the hot-shot, right-wing, weird and wild story of Canada's Progressive Conservatives, told through the journey of 18th Prime Minister Brian Mulroney's career as a Tory hopeful to the day of his inauguration.

title: Pranker
overview: Anton is a professional prankster. He believes that he is doing justice by tricking and then leaking secret information about corrupt officials and big shots. But one day, Anton himself finds himself drawn into a conflict between business competitors, in which the life of the prankster's sister is at stake.

title: Whiskey Throttle
overview: When a lone outsider infiltrates a cartel-run motocross empire and walks away with its kingpin's fortune, he becomes the target of a deadly pursuit stretching 100 miles across the desert to the border.

title: Ballboy
overview: While some kids are playing, the ball flies over into the yard of a nearby house. A boy who always serves as the ball boy climbs over the gate to retrieve it, only to find himself in a peculiar situation.

title: Relict
overview: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

title: Striguni
overview: Origolab, an internationally renowned genetical engineering company, establishes a new headquarters within the walls of a small medieval town in Istria and Boris, an ambitous up and coming biologist, gets a position in it. However, he discovers a terrifying secret: whilst Origolab might be on the verge of a scientific breakthrough with discovering eternal life, they have been kidnapping local children to achieve this, putting him before a moral dilemma. Should he try to save the most recent kidnapping victim? Or will he bend under the promise of the scientific discovery of a century?

title: To the Victory!
overview: A dystopian story set in post-war Ukraine, where a frustrated film director struggles to make the most of his life after being denied the opportunity to pursue his movie-making career. Estranged from his wife and daughter, who have been living in Vienna and are reluctant to return to their war-torn nation, the director tries to find solace in his conviction that the difficult times will pass and life will return to normal.

title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

title: Pirunduk
overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.

title: Nakee 3: The Cursed War
original_title: นาคี ๓ ครุฑา นาคี
overview: As destiny turns lovers into enemies, duty tears them apart, but love remembers what kingdoms forget, the love can end even the oldest war.

title: A Country Dog
overview: Based on Shirley Jackson's short story "The Renegade," A Country Dog follows a family whose move from the city to an isolated rural community promises a fresh start until their beloved dog is accused of killing a neighbor's chickens.

title: Making Marie Antoinette
overview: Eleanor Coppola's behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
original_title: バッド・ルーテナント:トウキョウ
overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

title: Wolf of the North
overview: A black comedy about Farley Pruitt Jr., an obsessive-but-inept wildlife filmmaker who travels to the far north to finish the wolf documentary that killed his father, but finds himself in a fierce battle against the elements, the wildlife, and his overly zealous 10-year-old son, who has snuck along for the expedition and is ruining his life dream.

title: Animol
overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

title: Falling into Place
overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: Forgotten Holiday
overview: Kathryn Liu is an antiques buyer for her father’s store and has been happily dating Rob Ashford for nearly a year. When he surprises her with a pre-Christmas proposal, her fear of a failed relationship sends her dashing away without giving him an answer. Heartbroken, as Rob drives to his sister’s house he has a car accident that leaves him without memories of the past year, including their relationship and his once-infectious love of Christmas. Following the unconventional orders from his doctor, Kathryn agrees to help trigger Rob’s memory by retracing their romance and reintroducing him to the holidays. But as his memories inch closer to returning, Kathryn must face the painful truth that bringing Rob back to himself may mean losing him forever, unless she can finally find the courage to fight for the love she was too afraid to claim.

title: Long Long Night
overview: The last rhino of his kind forms an unlikely bond with a penguin born from an abandoned egg. Together, they set out on a heartwarming journey toward the ocean.

title: Singh vs Kaur 2
overview: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

title: Don't Move
overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

title: Dahaan
overview: A malicious ancient spirit is unleashed in a haunted mansion. The girl's elder sister and younger brother team up with a pastor to find a way to end the curse which slowly consumes the girl who opened the box.

title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
original_title: ネルソンさん、あなたは人を殺しましたか？
overview: Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson returns with severe PTSD, winding up on the streets before crossing paths with Dr. Daniels of the Veterans Affairs who sets about trying to help him.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: BTS: THE RETURN
overview: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.

title: The Julia Set
overview: Julia, a gifted mathematician, navigates the cutthroat world of academia. Pascal, a teaching assistant, recruits her to join an exclusive training program for the prestigious and notoriously difficult Putnam mathematics competition.

title: Love-22-Love
overview: A candid film debut in which Jeroen Kooijmans uses home videos to trace his long struggle with depression, including a psychotic episode in New York in the wake of 9/11.

title: How to Generate a Perfect Crime
original_title: 5秒で完全犯罪を生成する方法
overview: After his sister, Sara, accidentally kills her threatening teacher in self-defense, Wataru makes a desperate decision to protect her. He uses an AI chatbot to generate a plan for the "perfect crime," staging the crime scene and covering up evidence based on the AI's instructions to make it look like a random homicide.

title: Chrysalis
original_title: Mãi Nợ Một Lời Tạm Biệt
overview: In war-torn 1970s Vietnam, a resourceful young boy navigates his place in a chaotic world, guided by his grandmother’s wisdom while haunted by memories of his fractured family.

title: Back to Buenos Aires
overview: It follows Mariano Guerra as he returns to Argentina to testify against soldiers who tortured him during the dictatorship, focusing not on revenge but on his inner struggle with guilt, trauma, and the lasting psychological impact of violence kept largely off-screen.

title: Santo António - Lisbon Love
original_title: Santo António - O Casamenteiro de Lisboa
overview: Lisbon's traditional Saint Anthony's Weddings have hit rock bottom. At least, that's what Stardust, a major French multinational poised to take over the event, believes. Carmo and Valentim, two Lisbon City Hall employees who have spent more than 25 years organizing the celebrations, are given a harsh ultimatum: reinvent the event and turn it into a modern success, or lose their jobs. Directed by the filmmaker behind The Gilded Cage, Saint Anthony is a vibrant comedy and a heartfelt love letter to Lisbon. A celebration of human connection, identity, and cultural resilience in an increasingly globalized world.

title: Lahukheda
overview: Two friends enter Lahukheda, a village feared after dark, and uncover a chilling tale of dead spirits, revenge, and a terrifying truth hidden behind local legends.

title: Neil Peart: No One's Disciple
overview: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson team up with four revered drummers — Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith, and Gavin Harrison — for an exhilarating and poignant tribute to late Rush legend Neil Peart.

title: The Prestige
overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

title: Vanessa Gonzalez: Mamona
overview: Comedian explores growing up in a Texas border town with a Catholic mother and witch grandmother, examining family chaos, cultural expectations, and the meaning of being called Mamona.

overview: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

title: Noise
overview: High from his rise to fame in an industry clamouring to promote him, a composer is privately challenged by his conductor. A film about how artists choose to defend their work, and where the blame falls if it all goes wrong.

title: Corpse Bride
overview: In a 19th-century European village, a young man about to be married is whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious corpse bride, while his real bride waits bereft in the land of the living.

title: Death Match King
overview: Matt Cardona’s shocking deathmatch against Nick Gage at GCW Homecoming 2021 became one of the most talked-about matches in modern professional wrestling history. In this documentary, we take a deep dive into the rivalry that shocked the wrestling world, the atmosphere leading into the match, the unforgettable moments inside the ring, and the aftermath that changed both men’s careers forever.

title: American Psycho
overview: A wealthy New York investment banking executive hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he escalates deeper into his illogical, gratuitous fantasies.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...

title: Jani Be Good
overview: Following her sister’s sudden flight from the household, a young woman acts as a clandestine intermediary between the runaway and their deeply fractured family, culminating in a critical four-day ultimatum where she must choose between sibling loyalty and the transparent truth required for domestic healing.

title: I Love Paris
overview: After being transformed into a vampire, a Parisian singer pursues stardom at the cost of her soul.

title: Hacksaw Ridge
overview: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

title: Chainsaw Man: The Stage - Reze Arc
original_title: 「チェンソーマン」ザ・ステージ レゼ篇
overview: The hugely popular manga "Chainsaw Man" by Tatsuki Fujimoto is being adapted into a stage play! The highly anticipated second installment "Reze Arc."

title: The Terminator
overview: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

title: Blessed Be The Profane
overview: A religious fanatic ends up awakening his own demons. Haunted by disturbing hallucinations that embody his deepest desires and nightmares, his sanity starts to collapse. Trapped by his own mind, he realizes that the only relief from his torment is total surrender to the sin he tried to suppress.

title: Booking
overview: Donna is a ride-hailing driver who sells her body to her passengers as extra service. But when she falls for her passenger Jane, will love stop Donna from doing the only way she knows how to pay her debts?

title: Maharaja Hostel
overview: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.

title: Echoes of Tomorrow
overview: In four thought-provoking sci-fi stories, people confront altered memories, forbidden love, artificial lifetimes and extraordinary powers. As time, identity and reality begin to shift, each must decide what truly makes a life worth living.

title: Take Care of Yourself
overview: Alaa, a radio host who fears commitment, enters relationships that end for trivial reasons until he meets Farida, who seems perfect. He then discovers she is one of the largest arms dealers. When he tries to leave her, she forces him to marry her, dragging him into a series of dangerous situations.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
overview: Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.

title: Jana Nayagan
overview: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
overview: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

title: Comédie-Française
overview: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

title: Someone's Daughter
overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

title: Alien Storm
overview: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

title: Forgotten things
overview: During a hypnosis session, Leo travels through his childhood memories and gradually discovers hidden, forgotten feelings...

title: Tangled
overview: Feisty teenager Rapunzel, who has long and magical hair, wants to go and see sky lanterns on her eighteenth birthday, but she's bound to a tower by her overprotective mother. She strikes a deal with Flynn Rider, a charming wanted thief, and the duo set off on an action-packed escapade.

title: Top Gun
overview: For Lieutenant Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick 'Goose' Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy, as well as personal demons, will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

title: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
original_title: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
overview: When a behavioral science major investigates murders at Capps Crossing, she finds herself trapped in a twisted web of lies surrounding the local ranger and his son.

title: Achyuta Avataaram
overview: A family's quiet life is upended by a devastating cyber scam that leaves them shattered. Determined to fight back, one woman takes on the digital underworld in a courageous battle for justice, hope and those she loves.

title: M.R.P (Neekentha Naakentha)
overview: Three roommates borrow money from a dangerous lender to start a business. When their plan fails, they face serious consequences. Caught in a risky situation, they must use their wits to survive and fix their mistakes.

title: AnyMart
overview: A supermarket as both a microcosm of Japanese society and the setting for a socially critical horror film. Expressionless faces and a supervisor who demands zombie-like friendliness. Only the young Sakai doesn’t stop hoping.

title: Captain Bonanza!
overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

title: You, Fireworks, and Our Promise
overview: The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

title: Goodbye, Monster
overview: A 12-year-old boy receives one final visit from the creature under his bed, forcing him to confront fear, loss, and the emotional cost of growing up.

title: Jennifer's Body
overview: Jennifer, a gorgeous, seductive cheerleader takes evil to a whole new level after she's possessed by a sinister demon. Now it's up to her best friend to stop Jennifer's reign of terror before it's too late.

title: Was haben wir gelacht
overview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

title: Die Hard 2
overview: One year after his heroics in Los Angeles, John McClane is an off-duty cop who is the wrong guy in the wrong place at the wrong time. On a snowy Christmas Eve, as he waits for his wife's plane to land at Washington Dulles International Airport, terrorists take over the air traffic control system in a plot to free a South American army general and drug smuggler being flown into the US to face drug charges. It's now up to McClane to take on the terrorists, while coping with an inept airport police chief, an uncooperative anti-terrorist squad, and the life of his wife and everyone else trapped in planes circling overhead.

title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
overview: After surviving the Quarter Quell, Katniss finds herself in the hidden stronghold of District 13, where the rebellion against the Capitol is gaining momentum. Struggling with the weight of becoming the symbol of resistance, she must navigate fragile alliances while trying to protect those she loves. As propaganda battles rage and Panem moves closer to full-scale war, Katniss is forced to confront the true cost of revolution.

title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
overview: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

title: Le Pride Comedy Show de Juste pour Rire 2026
original_title: Le Pride Comedy Show de Juste pour Rire 2026
overview: On the occasion of Pride 2026, a special spotlight is shone on the Pride Comedy Show, which made its way to Quebec as part of the 2026 Just For Laughs festival. Dedicated this year to cinema, this brand-new evening celebrates the pride of being oneself through the talents of the francophone LGBTQIA+ comedy scene. A festive, inclusive, and unapologetic event, brought together under the banner of laughter and living together.

title: The Odyssey
overview: After being falsely accused of treason by a jealous king, the legendary warrior Alexander is exiled to a forbidden monster filled realm and tasked with an impossible challenge: slay three ancient Titans or die trying. Armed with a mystical medallion, a legendary sword, and the help of unlikely allies, Alexander embarks on an epic quest to save the woman he loves, reclaim his honor, and prevent a tyrant from seizing his kingdom.

title: Evil Dead
overview: Mia, a drug addict, is determined to kick the habit. To that end, she asks her brother, David, his girlfriend, Natalie and their friends Olivia and Eric to accompany her to their family's remote forest cabin to help her through withdrawal. Eric finds a mysterious Book of the Dead at the cabin and reads aloud from it, awakening an ancient demon. All hell breaks loose when the malevolent entity possesses Mia.

title: King
overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

title: Strange Tales of Bangjia Town
overview: In the early years of the Republic of China era, there are multiple cases of the Clam God killing people in Bangjia Town. The provincial police send Ji Hechuan and a team to investigate, and they acquire the help of Cheng Yueyao, who does not believe in the Clam God curse. They learn from a local, Xiu, that a ghost marriage with Young Master Cheng, who is said to be the reincarnation of the Clam God, fell through, because the bride Lu Mingyue escaped seven days ago. The Clam God is enraged...

title: Me Before Me
overview: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
overview: After Dr. Bill Harford's wife, Alice, admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

title: Siping
overview: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Life Support
overview: Since October 2023, Gaza has been sealed from the world-except for one group. International doctors breach the blockade, what they find is not just a humanitarian crisis, but a calculated dismantling of life itself.

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
original_title: 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。 44:CLOUDY BEACH
overview: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

title: Goblin II
overview: Five years later, Sara and Sam face off against a familiar foe amidst a village in chaos, risking everything to protect what they love as evil rises again.

title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
original_title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: Las 48 horas que lo cambiaron todo
overview: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
overview: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

title: Narcisa's Will
overview: Haunted by memories of her recently deceased mother, former star Narcisa, Ana decides to sell the childhood mansion she inherited and share the proceeds with her brother, Diego. However, the grim cleansing process reveals a legacy quite different from what she imagined.

title: Music, Fashion, Film
overview: A companion film to the Charli xcx album of the same name, Music, Fashion, Film presents a series of docu-style clips, behind-the-scenes footage, and in-studio footage shot by close friends.

title: Murder Game
overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 July
overview: Nighter in Korakuen 2026 July was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on July 8, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. In the main event, 02line (AZM and Miyu Amasaki) defended the Goddesses of Stardom Championship against Hai High Mate (Maika and HANAKO).

title: The Hoodoos
overview: When a crew of criminals attempts to steal cursed Confederate gold from a haunted Louisiana plantation, they discover that the voodoo protecting the treasure is terrifyingly real… and the dolls are awake.

title: Shrek the Third
overview: After the King of Far Far Away dies, Shrek and Fiona are to succede. However, Shrek wants to return to his cozy swamp and live in peace and quiet, so when he finds out there is another heir to the throne, he and Donkey set off to bring him back to rule the kingdom.

title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
original_title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

title: Marave
overview: It follows Manolo, a gentle, naive fairground worker. When their father gets sick, Manolo reunites with his older brother Georges, a con man who abandoned the family twenty years ago. Desperate to prove he is not a failure, Georges schemes to turn the physically strong Manolo into an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) champion.

title: The Empire Strikes Back
overview: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

title: GoodFellas
overview: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.

title: One Piece Heroines
overview: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

title: KILL ROOM
overview: Brooke spirals after a freak car accident on a New Zealand backroad, until her friends suggest visiting the “kill room” for answers, a new rumored urban legend that supposedly shows you anything that’s ever died by your hand.

title: Pendulum
overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

title: Halloween
overview: Laurie Strode comes to her final confrontation with Michael Myers, the masked figure who has haunted her since she narrowly escaped his killing spree on Halloween night four decades ago.

title: Gremlins, an american nightmare!
overview: 1984. Produced by Steven Spielberg, fresh off the historic success of E.T., a film that blended horror and comedy managed to break Warner’s box-office record, spark a parental controversy, become the first merchandising success since *Star Wars*, and lay the groundwork for satire, six years later, of that very commercial success—in a kamikaze sequel that threw its original blueprint overboard, replacing it with the most anarchic spectacle ever produced with a blockbuster’s budget. A look back at Gremlins 1 & 2, the most irreverent phenomenon of its time, as told by its director and his closest collaborators—the real parasites behind this prophetic sabotage!

title: Helena
overview: Helena, the only hilot in a small town who secretly has affairs with her patients' husbands. After a pregnant patient dies upon discovering Helena's affair with her own husband, the enraged townsfolk turn against her.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: Tropical SOV: Bizarre Sci-fi Samba
overview: Once again, 23 Brazilian filmmakers come together for the second Tropical SOV anthology, now exploring sci-fi in humorous stories involving aliens and their space invasions, mad scientists, time travel, dystopias, and a myriad of end-of-the-world scenarios.

title: Simpsley
overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she's tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner's clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

title: Operasi Pesta Copet
overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

title: God Skin
original_title: หมัดเทวา ท้าเดิมพัน
overview: Win, takes a lethal gamble to fund his mother's medical treatment when Itt, an old friend, lures him into the Arena. In this brutal underground circuit, fighters are marked with "God Skin" tattoos to gain a ruthless edge.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

title: Terminator, des machines et des hommes... et une femme
original_title: Terminator, des machines et des hommes... et une femme

title: Liebe braucht Meer
overview: Lissi Strack, a young lawyer, travels with her mother Silvia, the owner of an internationally renowned law firm specializing in insolvency, to the Breton port city of Cancale. When Silvia has a mishap during the trip and is hit by a car driven by the young Alain Demur, she has no choice but to return home. This gives Lissi the chance to step in for Silvia, find an investor on her own, and finally prove herself to her mother.

title: Blade
overview: The Daywalker known as "Blade" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

title: The Meltdown
overview: 1992, Chile. Inés parents are away on business and she is left in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
overview: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

title: Toy Story 4
overview: Woody has always been confident about his place in the world, devoted to taking care of his kid—whether that's Andy or Bonnie. But after Bonnie creates a reluctant new toy called "Forky", a road trip adventure alongside old and new friends challenges everything Woody believes about loyalty, purpose, and what it truly means to be a toy.

title: Pay to Die
overview: While putting together a horror movie, a group of filmmakers are terrorized by a killer after hiring the wrong person for the job.

title: The Making of The Final Sacrifice
original_title: The Making of The Final Sacrifice
overview: An in-depth documentary on the behind-the-scenes of the 1990 Canuck cult classic The Final Sacrifice.

title: Hide
overview: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.

title: Ce qui nous mène à toi
original_title: Ce qui nous mène à toi
overview: Charlie and Hicham, both in their thirties, are deeply in love but unable to conceive; they are facing infertility. They embark on a journey of medically assisted reproduction. Over the course of three years—amidst hopes and disappointments—they put both their love and their bodies to the test, living through an odyssey that will profoundly transform them.

title: DreamQuil
overview: Set in the not so distant future when poor air quality leads to people living mostly virtual lives. Carol is a dissatisfied career mother, struggling to find connection within her marriage to Gary and her child. With the day to day familiarity of their home and lives feeling increasingly claustrophobic, and worried she could be heading towards divorce, Carol leaps at the chance to get her life back on track by signing up for "DreamQuil", an avant-garde digital wellness retreat. When Carol returns home however, she discovers her family has been living with "Carol 2", a robot the corporation sent designed to help in her absence, and things take a mysterious and sinister turn.

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
overview: Count Dracula, a 15th-century prince, is condemned to live off the blood of the living for eternity. Young lawyer Jonathan Harker is sent to Dracula's castle to finalise a land deal, but when the Count sees a photo of Harker's fiancée, Mina, the spitting image of his dead wife, he imprisons him and sets off for London to track her down.

title: Batulo Jun
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: The Serpent Spirit Goddess
overview: Dedi, a man who is bankrupt and deep in debt, performs a ritual to marry a beautiful jinn named Dewi in order to get the money to pay off his debts—with one condition: he must never marry anyone else.  As Dedi grows richer and more prosperous, he suddenly falls in love with a woman and intends to marry her. Dewi becomes furious because Dedi has forgotten the condition of the ritual, and eventually, a series of terrifying events threatens the lives of those closest to Dedi.

title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
overview: The Peanuts kids are on their best behavior—but Snoopy has landed on Santa’s naughty list. With just 12 days until Christmas, he sets out to prove he’s not such a bad beagle after all, discovering along the way that the season is about more than gifts.

title: Bo Bo
overview: Nadya was born with a pathology. She has a large red-burgundy hemangioma on her small face. In the native village Nadya faces the hostility and ridicule of others, furthermore her own family does not accept the girl as she is. Nadya grandmother tries to treat her illness with all religious methods she knows, while Nadya mother constantly dreams of a surgical operation in Moscow. Nadya just wants to be herself. Her only wish is to sing in the choir. After getting into another mess, she ends up in a Moscow hospital, where meets people like her. But even after the physical problem has been resolved nothing changes in her family life.

title: God with Us
overview: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

title: The Child
overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
overview: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek warns that PawPaw's health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.

title: Die Otissee
overview: The extraordinary journey of Otis Seuss.

title: L'Autre
overview: Bedridden following a severe cancer, a man sees his recovery falter when his young roommate begins to stir up his deepest fears.

title: Al Wat Ek Weet
overview: When a car accident claims his mother's life and his father withdraws from life in a clinic, seventeen-year-old Gabriel Lombard is uprooted from his green, leafy suburb on Table Mountain and sent to live with his aunt Lotta and grandmother Lenie in a cramped house in Woodstock. Determined not to collapse like his father, he buries his grief behind a cool facade, wild lies and an overactive imagination.

title: My Dad is an Alien
overview: The father who wants to become a full score alone to raise his daughter, even in order to let his daughter to go to a better school, by selling fried rice even saved up a set of school district housing, but just when everything life into the right track, a sudden accident, so that the daughter surprised to find out the identity of her father's "aliens" in the daughter's worshipful gaze, the old Jin can do anything to perform "super powers". Under his daughter's adoring gaze, Lao Jin performs his "supernatural powers" in an all-powerful manner. However, what is the hidden agenda under the well-intentioned lies of Chinese parents? Behind the flourishing love, will the daughter be able to see through the deep secrets of her "alien father"? An adventure of love and wonder begins…

title: Mother
overview: Mother is an emotional Tamil family drama that explores the profound dynamics, deep love, and selfless sacrifices inherent in motherhood. Following a limited theatrical release through digital cinema networks like SDC, this intimate, small-scale production captures a moving and relatable narrative about core familial bonds.

title: How to Divorce During the War
overview: On the eve of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, a high-flying executive tells her husband she wants a divorce, forcing the couple to navigate their bitter separation amid an escalating mid-life crisis and an unfolding regional refugee emergency.

title: Bardaasht
overview: After being falsely imprisoned, Karma returns to his village determined to take revenge on the man who destroyed his family.

title: Learning to Fly
overview: Aisha McAdams, a former competitive runner turned photographer, embarks on a journey to document the triumphs and struggles of famed ultra trailrunners, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag. Traveling to mythical races—the Western States Endurance Run in the mountains of eastern California, the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc in the French Alps—the film marvels at athletes who maintain their intensity as they run 100 miles of mountain trails while climbing thousands of vertical feet.

title: Elisa and the letter
overview: Elisa leads her friend Leonora into an art studio. While her friend acts like an ill-at-ease guest, Elisa navigates the chaotic space with ease and, amid the paintings and the hidden corners, uncovers a stack of love letters with no addressee. Fascinated, the two friends begin to recite them, unaware that those words hide a secret involving one of them.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
overview: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

title: Di Renjie: Six Dragon Phases
overview: When Di Renjie first took office as the Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, he was tasked with investigating the whereabouts of the six Xuanlong artifacts that Chancellor Han had left behind several years earlier. Di Renjie traveled between Taoist temples, secret cult strongholds, and ancient ruins in search of the artifacts, eventually discovering that using all six together would create an illusion that could cause people to die suddenly. Within the illusion of the ruins, Lord Li, consumed by his desire for immortality, succumbed to the poison and died. Di Renjie then destroyed all the artifacts, safeguarding the peace of the Tang Dynasty.

title: Khalifa: The Ruler
overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: Where Is Your Faith
overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

title: Ice Skater
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: Vart är vi på väg?
overview: Through meetings with researchers, "polfluencers," opinion leaders, politicians, and others, comedian Finn Aldén Joyce seeks answers to some of the most hotly debated questions of our time. Why does "woke" seem to be out and traditional values ​​in? Young women and men are drifting further apart politically—what does this mean? The global power structure is shifting rapidly, and the question is what it will look like in the future. Why is democracy in decline across large parts of the world?

title: Born in the Jungle
overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.

title: Dracula
overview: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet with the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves and drives the agent to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.

title: Joshua
overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

title: No Fairy Dust
overview: It follows Marija an ice skater who lives with her father. When her father's girlfriend moves in, Marija realizes that she cannot trust her. The love of a young businessman will give her the strength to accept herself and her sexuality.

title: Speed and Battle
overview: A pair of estranged father and son are forced to team up amid a city destruction crisis triggered by drone technology, fighting against a frantic conspiracy at life-threatening speed. This is not only a race to stop disaster, but also a chance to fix their broken relationship.

title: Jupiter
