overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

title: Guarding Stars
overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

title: Agnes & Amir
original_title: Lieblingsmenschen - Die außergewöhnliche Freundschaft von Agnes & Amir
overview: Amir is 28, gay and has just fled from Iran. Agnes is 101 and still too young for a retirement home - she thinks. The two move in together - and save each other's lives.

title: Canned Heat
overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

title: Dark Horse
overview: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

title: The Rainbow Fish
overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.

title: Electric Mushrooms
overview: As the Cheshire Cat once said: Imagination is the only weapon in the war against reality. This is Electric Mushrooms...

title: The Raid
overview: Deep in the heart of Jakarta's slums lies an impenetrable safe house for the world's most dangerous killers and gangsters. Until now, the run-down apartment block has been considered untouchable to even the bravest of police. Cloaked under the cover of pre-dawn darkness and silence, an elite swat team is tasked with raiding the safe house in order to take down the notorious drug lord that runs it.  But when a chance encounter with a spotter blows their cover and news of their assault reaches the drug lord, the building's lights are cut and all the exits blocked. Stranded on the sixth floor with no way out, the unit must fight their way through the city's worst to survive their mission. Starring Indonesian martial arts sensation Iko Uwais.

title: The Airport Chaplain
overview: At a bustling international airport, lost people seek missed connections, while others carry heavy personal baggage. Tobias Wallace shepherds them all. Scruffy and benevolent in his hi-vis “Chaplain”-printed vest and always on call, he’ll bend rules to help passengers and workers alike – that includes Asha, a young woman hiding in the prayer room whose murky history stirs Tobias’s own deeply buried traumas. Not everybody is a fan of his methods, however: ambitious new terminal manager Mira has liability nightmare Tobias marked for redundancy. But as crises appear everywhere – overworked baggage handlers, security breaches, families torn apart and grief-stricken relatives – maybe this infuriating chaplain could be Mira’s salvation.

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

title: Best Pancakes in the County
overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own. As loyalties blur and tensions erupt, survival depends on who can outthink – and outgun – everyone else. In this diner, the 'best pancakes in the county' turn out to be the least explosive thing on the menu.

title: The Widower
overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

title: D23 Horizons: Disney Experiences Showcase
overview: Join host Neil Patrick Harris for a journey into the stories shaping the future of Disney Experiences around the world at “D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event.” Building on the ambitious projects announced in 2024, this showcase takes fans deeper into the creative vision behind what’s to come, hearing directly from the Imagineers, storytellers, artists, and innovators bringing these experiences to life. Inspired by the Carousel of Progress, Harris guides engaging conversations, behind-the-scenes looks, special performances, exciting announcements, and a few surprises along the way.

title: The Green Mile
overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.

title: Haplos Ni Milagros
overview: VMX Star Vern Kaye takes on a bold new role as Milagros, a young beautiful faith healer who uses her healing hands to cure Erwin’s problem with his manhood. But when she falls for him, her powers begin to fade. Will she choose love or her gift to heal?

title: Hushar Pittalu
overview: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
original_title: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich
overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: Magudam
overview: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

title: All Night Wrong
overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: User Not Found
overview: Two men and women with unknown identities, a live online trial in a confined space, and an extreme escape between death and truth

title: This, That, and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: Perumahan Laddaland
overview: A devoted father’s dream of providing a better life for his family turns into a living nightmare when their newly purchased suburban home becomes the target of escalating supernatural terror and dark neighborhood secrets.

title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit - Extended Movie Cut
original_title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit - Extended Movie Cut
overview: Join the Doctor and Rose as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.

title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
overview: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.

title: Drift
overview: Over the course of a single night, a convoy of cars carries intimate conversations on the representation of Black bodies in France.

title: Yo, Narciso
overview: Rocío Flores is a sociologist writing a book about modern narcissism. For her investigation, she acts as the patient of Máximo Rey, a charismatic and egocentric plastic surgeon, triggering a series of hilarious scenarios.

title: Leave This Room Buried
overview: A poetic personal journey through the director's memories of the past and present, presented through unconventional combinations of images and sounds and the haunting presence of silence that threatens to whisk them away into the oblivion.

title: Un grand raccourci
overview: When their family restaurant is on the verge of closing, two cousins release rats in an attempt to set themselves up as pest control experts. That same summer, two young women rig the local beauty contest to promote their jewelry. Caught up in their chaotic schemes, these four resourceful young people searching for a better future eventually cross paths.

title: Curse of the Shark
overview: When a marine biology team explore unusual shark activity in Central America, they discover the horrifying truth behind an island legend.

title: Way of the Warrior Kid
overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

title: Trago Seu Amor
overview: Mia is a self-centered witch who possesses an unusual power: whoever kisses her falls in love with her or falls back in love with the last person they loved. In one of her jobs, however, she ends up falling in love with the woman she was supposed to cast a spell on.

title: Dosa: Penebusan atau Pengampunan
overview: Bima and her wife, Ersya, have an accident while they're going out of the town and they are trapped in a mysterious hotel, where they are terrorized and forced to face past sins that cannot be avoided.

title: The VelociPastor 2
overview: The perfect movie DOES exist! Doug and Carol travel to the port city of Milan, where they have to solve a series of murders committed by a masked slasher at an Italian Fertility Festival. And Soviet Spies. INTERPOL’s there, too.

title: Kijsada Paradise
original_title: กฤษดา พาราไดซ์
overview: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

title: How to Talk Australians: The Movie
original_title: How to Talk Australians: The Movie
overview: A group of students and teachers from The Delhi College of Linguistics hit the road to discover Australia and gain first-hand experience of its authentic language and culture. When their plane is diverted to the country town of Dubbo due to storms, and their tour-leader is detained by customs, the hapless bunch unearth the 'real' Australia while never making it to Sydney, Melbourne...or even Brisbane.

title: Manok
overview: Manok, the owner of a South Korean lesbian bar, trades rainbow lights for small-town politics when she moves back home and challenges her ex-husband for mayor.

title: Project Baby
overview: The story follows Sandy, a 30-something advertising executive who, fearing her biological clock is ticking, launches "Project Baby"—a step-by-step mission to conceive a child on her own terms with a no-strings-attached donor. She selects Migo, a sensitive artist, but quickly realizes that meticulous plans can't account for human emotion.

title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
overview: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

title: Vertiginous
overview: Jacques goes to his friend Bruno's house to tell him some big news: the entire human race is living in a simulation...

title: A Second Life
overview: July 26, 2024 — the day of the Olympic Games Opening Ceremony. Elisabeth, a hearing impaired young woman, is torn between depression and the pressure of managing short-term rentals in a hectic Paris. The arrival of Elijah, a radiant and carefree Californian, disrupts her fragile balance.

title: Son of a Bitch
overview: The quiet city of Veredas is home to Casa Rosa, a famous brothel in the backlands of Minas Gerais managed by Ismael's mother, known to everyone as O Filho da Puta. Tired of his life, the young man leaves with his dog towards the coast in search of the father he never knew. Along the way, he finds himself faced with situations that, at the same time as they transform him, insist on reminding him of the fate he is fleeing.

title: Blue Hour
overview: Joey, a student from Yorkshire, keeps his head down and works quietly, more comfortable with tools than with people. The workshop is familiar to him - noisy, practical, predictable. That changes when Skyla, an exchange student from Texas, joins the course. She's open, direct, and out of place in a way that immediately stands out.

title: Sugar Mommy
overview: When a non-committal sugar mommy takes in her three sugar babies, jealousy erupts as one of them becomes determined to be her one and only.

title: The Man I Love
overview: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

title: Let's Love
overview: When a director, actor, screenwriter and actress reunite for the 10th Anniversary of their one-hit wonder film for a convention that suddenly gets cancelled, they must improvise and come up with ideas for a sequel while in rural Wales.

title: Dogman
overview: A boy, bruised by life, finds his salvation through the love of his dogs.

title: The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony
overview: The birth of a gymnastics team in Pakistan provides an inspiring spark of light for a small group of girls on the margins.

title: LITTLE GREEN MEN: QUIP'S IN CHARGE
original_title: LITTLE GREEN MEN: QUIP'S IN CHARGE
overview: Quip, the assistant to the evil space empress Eclipse, is eager to prove his worth; He finally gets his chance when he’s left in charge of the ship for the day - but he soon finds out he bites off more than he can chew. Can Quip and his trusty friend Proko be able to right their wrongs save the day? (Probably not...)

title: The Ideas
overview: A woman creates fake dating profiles until she runs into one of the men she has deceived.

title: Árru
overview: Sámi reindeer herder Maia fights to protect her ancestral lands from a looming mining project. Amid the growing protests, she is also confronted with deeply buried family traumas. Maia is forced to make a decision.

title: Your Story
overview: Chihiro, a university student who lives a lonely life, undergoes a treatment to erase his memories in order to forget his unhappy past. However, when he awakens, his memories have not disappeared. Instead, he is left with memories of his first love with Toka, a childhood friend he has never even met. She is supposed to exist only within fabricated memories. Yet before long, Chihiro finds himself unable to get her out of his mind. But one day, Toka appears in the real world.

title: KJQ
overview: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

title: Her Trepidation
overview: Pahinag falls lucid in her dream re-living her traumatic past. She wants to change what was done on her but has to avoid the hazards that come along the way.

title: G.D.N
overview: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

title: Мастер
overview: The documentary "Master" is dedicated to one of the most prominent figures in the history of Russian cinema—the brilliant film scholar, Chairman of the Russian State Cinematography Committee, professor at VGIK, and longtime president of the Window to Europe film festival—Armen Nikolaevich Medvedev. The film's central focus is the 1990s, a turning point for the country and a pivotal moment in Medvedev's career. Separate chapters are devoted to VGIK and the Vyborg Film Festival, the film's subject's beloved creative outlets. The film draws on the recollections of colleagues, friends, and students, who speak with sincere warmth and gratitude about the master's role in their lives and the life of Russian cinema.

title: Ang Modista
overview: A provocative story about a seamstress who uses her body to attract more customers, until the arrival of one man that changes her life forever.

title: Mamma Mia: How Unexpected!
overview: Two strangers meet each other and improvise a first date

title: Olmo
overview: When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her, embarking on a night of laughs and chaos.

title: Q-Pop
overview: Q-POP follows 23-year-old Quechua artist and viral sensation Lenin Tamayo, creator of “Q-Pop,” a genre that fuses K-Pop with Quechua, an Indigenous tongue that has endured for centuries but faces an uncertain future among younger generations. As his music gains national attention in Peru and begins attracting fans around the world, Lenin journeys from a working-class neighborhood outside Lima to the streets of Seoul, chasing a dream that once seemed impossible. Along the way, he takes on a mission larger than his own success: using pop music to help preserve and revitalize the language of his ancestors.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Thudakkam
overview: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

title: DC
overview: Rebel Devadas joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stake in their fight.

title: MAJU (Jejak Pahit si Kembang Gula)
overview: Mr. Wira is a teacher and scout leader for a group of his students. They plan to survey the location of the Scout Jamboree in Segosari village. Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: Cannelloni
overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

title: Princess Mononoke
overview: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.

title: The Bourne Identity
overview: Wounded to the brink of death and suffering from amnesia, Jason Bourne is rescued at sea by a fisherman. With nothing to go on but a Swiss bank account number, he starts to reconstruct his life, but finds that many people he encounters want him dead. However, Bourne realizes that he has the combat and mental skills of a world-class spy—but who does he work for?

title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
original_title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
overview: The Dwarves, Bilbo and Gandalf have successfully escaped the Misty Mountains, and Bilbo has gained the One Ring. They all continue their journey to get their gold back from the Dragon, Smaug.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: Time of an Alarm Clock
overview: A writer has her alarm clock stolen after a sexual encounter.

title: Sin City
overview: Welcome to Sin City. This town beckons to the tough, the corrupt, the brokenhearted. Some call it dark… Hard-boiled. Then there are those who call it home — Crooked cops, sexy dames, desperate vigilantes. Some are seeking revenge, others lust after redemption, and then there are those hoping for a little of both. A universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes still trying to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday
overview: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

title: Storm on Sesame Street
overview: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

title: Son Perde Aşk
overview: Gizem tries to maintain the routine she's built over the years while raising her daughter Bade alone. As Bade's questions about her father, whom she's never met, intensify, she makes an unusual deal with Onur, a theater artist. Onur will temporarily assume the role of Bade's father. What begins as a simple game unexpectedly changes the lives of all three. Secrets from the past, established dynamics, and developing emotions force Gizem to confront the most difficult decisions of her life.

title: It Will Happen Tonight
overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Saturday
overview: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

title: Anemoia
overview: Marcos has been living most of his life on autopilot, as a spectator, daydreaming of something better than his current situation, until the father who abandoned him as a child knocks on his door.

title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
original_title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
overview: A rebellious student and a perfectionist overachiever form an unlikely alliance in their race for student body president, discovering unexpected feelings along the way.

title: Horror Anthology Volume 2
overview: The Creator and Producers of DOLLY present their second anthology collection of horror short films including the cold open to A VERY LOVELY GIRL.

title: Meu Nome é Enéas: Muito Além dos 15 Segundos
original_title: Meu Nome é Enéas: Muito Além dos 15 Segundos

title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
original_title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
overview: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

title: Obsess
overview: Lucy Bel, a literary icon and woman of power, sees her empire threatened by an admirer whose fascination turns into obsession. When admiration is no longer enough, becoming her becomes a necessity. How far must one go to stay on top?

title: Superplastic Deformation
overview: “I poured all of my own thoughts and feelings into this work. This work is, in essence, myself, my body, and proof of my existence. It is like an autobiography.” - Sion Sono

title: Blind Road
overview: Completed in 2019, this short film remained unreleased for years before finally premiering at various film festivals in 2025, where it screened to critical acclaim and won multiple awards. In 2026, it made its official broadcast debut on television and was released online for global audiences.  Driven by Dhaka's relentless traffic, a reckless motorcyclist dangerously rode onto a sidewalk, terrifying pedestrians and aggressively confronting a visually impaired man who was using the guided path. As an outraged crowd gathered to confront the illegal rider for his blatant disregard for safety and decency, the blind man remarkably stepped in to shield his aggressor. Ultimately, his unexpected act of grace transformed a moment of hostility into a powerful lesson in compassion.

title: The Martian
overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

title: Bhai Tera Star Hai
overview: An actor's cricket gambling debt puts him on a deadly deadline. His lie about his sister sets off a catastrophic evening of confused criminals, botched crimes, and pandemonium racing across London.

title: The Gorals
overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

title: Fuga 22
overview: A snappy and hyper-saturated ode and eulogy to growing up in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, and immigrating to Canada. A slice of life through the lens of a camcorder.

title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
overview: Super-assassin John Wick returns with a $14 million price tag on his head and an army of bounty-hunting killers on his trail. After killing a member of the shadowy international assassin’s guild, the High Table, John Wick is excommunicado, but the world’s most ruthless hit men and women await his every turn.

title: Mean Girls
overview: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

title: Lady Gaga - My Songs. My Life.
original_title: Lady Gaga - My Songs. My Life.

title: Noise
overview: High from his rise to fame in an industry clamouring to promote him, a composer is privately challenged by his conductor. A film about how artists choose to defend their work, and where the blame falls if it all goes wrong.

title: Death Match King
overview: Matt Cardona’s shocking deathmatch against Nick Gage at GCW Homecoming 2021 became one of the most talked-about matches in modern professional wrestling history. In this documentary, we take a deep dive into the rivalry that shocked the wrestling world, the atmosphere leading into the match, the unforgettable moments inside the ring, and the aftermath that changed both men’s careers forever.

title: Jani Be Good
overview: Following her sister’s sudden flight from the household, a young woman acts as a clandestine intermediary between the runaway and their deeply fractured family, culminating in a critical four-day ultimatum where she must choose between sibling loyalty and the transparent truth required for domestic healing.

title: I Love Paris
overview: After being transformed into a vampire, a Parisian singer pursues stardom at the cost of her soul.

title: Chainsaw Man: The Stage - Reze Arc
original_title: 「チェンソーマン」ザ・ステージ レゼ篇
overview: The hugely popular manga "Chainsaw Man" by Tatsuki Fujimoto is being adapted into a stage play! The highly anticipated second installment "Reze Arc."

title: The Canary's Lullaby
overview: In a storm-scared village, 70-year-old Tae lives a quiet life until she rescues Haru, a mysterious mountain creature. As she feeds and nurtures him with her wanzi, she finds a renewed sense of purpose. However, when rumors of a monster spread, fear turns the villagers against them. Tae is forcibly hospitalized, and Haru is hunted as a harbinger of disaster. To protect him, she stages a fake funeral. When a new storm strikes, Tae must learn that love is not possession but letting go.

title: Samo Lives
overview: A vibrant portrait of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the NYC artist who revolutionized 1980s art. From street graffiti to gallery stardom, his bold Neo-expressionist works left an indelible mark on the art world and beyond.

title: Blessed Be The Profane
overview: A religious fanatic ends up awakening his own demons. Haunted by disturbing hallucinations that embody his deepest desires and nightmares, his sanity starts to collapse. Trapped by his own mind, he realizes that the only relief from his torment is total surrender to the sin he tried to suppress.

title: Sour Minnows
overview: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty L.A. street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As reality grows porous and memory begins to slip, a delirious new logic takes hold.

title: Euphoria: A Look Back
overview: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

title: Lost Chapters
overview: When Ena returns to Venezuela, after spending several years abroad, she discovers a postcard in her father's bookshop and sets off in search of a forgotten writer.

title: Haunted Heist
overview: Four estranged friends reunite at what appears to be a typical house, But one friend has ulterior motives; he plans to rob the place and needs their help to find an antique worth a fortune. But the house is straight up haunted, and the group must squash their differences to survive the night and an insane pack of ghosts.

title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
original_title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
overview: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again as the journey of Rey, Finn and Poe Dameron continues. With the power and knowledge of generations behind them, the final battle begins.

title: Booking
overview: Donna is a ride-hailing driver who sells her body to her passengers as extra service. But when she falls for her passenger Jane, will love stop Donna from doing the only way she knows how to pay her debts?

title: Arrival
overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.

title: Worth More Than Gold
overview: A resilient woman trying to outrun a traumatic past crosses paths with a man fighting to redeem himself from a life of crime together they battle secrets, betrayal, and survival, discovering that true love is worth more than gold

title: Nameless
overview: The story begins with an indiscriminate slaughter at a cafe frequented by young people. Security camera footage shows an unarmed man with shaven head, able to seemingly kill people with a simple touch. Police investigation leads to the suspected identity of the murderer: middle-aged man named Tarō Yamada. When the police conduct a search of his apartment, they find the rotting corpse of a woman.  Adapted from Sato Jiro's own debut manga.

title: The End
overview: A stop-motion doomsday comedy, in which airport-bound creatures wait out the impending apocalypse.

title: THE CRIME PREVENTERS Part One | Movie
original_title: THE CRIME PREVENTERS Part One | Movie
overview: The first chapter in “THE CRIME PREVENTERS” universe. A government pilot's helicopter, containing dangerous cargo crashes, leaving it exposed to the public.

title: Chand Mera Dil
overview: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

title: The Balloonists
overview: Follows the improbable team of Bertrand Piccard and Brian Jones, who, in 1999, competed against the world's finest pilots and extremely wealthy adventurers to become the first individuals to fly a hot air balloon around the globe nonstop.

title: Notting Hill
overview: London bookstore owner William Thacker's quiet life turns upside down when a chance encounter with famous actress Anna Scott sparks an unlikely romance challenged by their vastly different worlds.

title: Back to the Future Part III
original_title: Back to the Future Part III
overview: The final installment finds Marty digging the trusty DeLorean out of a mineshaft and looking for Doc in the Wild West of 1885. But when their time machine breaks down, the travelers are stranded in a land of spurs. More problems arise when Doc falls for pretty schoolteacher Clara Clayton, and Marty tangles with Buford Tannen.

title: Musk's Dream of Mars: The Price on Earth
overview: With dreams of colonising Mars and beyond, billionaires such as Elon Musk or Jeff Bezos are fuelling a boom in the space industry. But many criticise the pollution and resources needed for such an endeavour. By promising humanity’s survival through an escape into space, New Space may be contributing to the destruction of our planet.

title: LOVE
overview: A gorgeous and frequently emotional rumination on the “big things” in life, James Gallagher’s new short film, Love, poses questions on what we love, why we love it, and what happens when the desire to win becomes detrimental to our experience of ourselves and other people. While that description seems preachy, the film is not didactic—on the contrary, its plot is extremely loose and impressionistic, requiring the viewer some effort to construct its fast-moving snippets into a coherent narrative.

title: Possessed
overview: Nut, a young nurse, returns to her hometown to care for her recovering mother, but she encounters a terrifying case that involves Mac, a boy who is believed to be possessed.

title: Niccolò
overview: From innocent to genius. Niccolò is a young violonist destined to become a legend.

title: Bearcave
overview: Set in the Greek mountain village of Tirna, Bearcave follows Argyro, a badass farmer, and her best friend Anneta, the village "it" girl and local manicurist. Once Anneta admits that she's pregnant and planning to leave town with her lame cop boyfriend, Argyro challenges Anneta to embark on an adventure to find the mystical bear cave. Before Argyro has a chance to confess her own love, Anneta leaves for her new life in the big city. Argyro is left broken. Meanwhile, in her new home with her clingy mother-in-law, Anneta quickly realizes her destiny lies elsewhere.

title: Insidious
overview: A family discovers that dark spirits have invaded their home after their son inexplicably falls into an endless sleep. When they reach out to a professional for help, they learn things are a lot more personal than they thought.

title: El Salvador: O Dia em que o Medo Mudou de Lado
original_title: El Salvador: O Dia em que o Medo Mudou de Lado

title: Speed Demon
overview: Aboard a high-speed train, a nun who has lost her faith must perform her first exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

title: Titanic Ocean
overview: Kyoko, a young Japanese girl training to become a professional mermaid, is saved by her coach's mouth-to-mouth "kiss of life". Desire awakens within her, she finds her mermaid voice and discovers the devastating effects of her singing, which will lead her to face the other side of the world.

title: The Prestige
overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

title: Shrek 2
overview: Happily ever after never seemed so far far away when a trip to meet the in-laws turns into a hilariously twisted adventure for Shrek and Fiona. With the help of ever-faithful Donkey, Shrek takes on the potion-brewing Fairy Godmother, pompous Prince Charming, and infamous ogre-killer Puss In Boots.

title: AnyMart
overview: A supermarket as both a microcosm of Japanese society and the setting for a socially critical horror film. Expressionless faces and a supervisor who demands zombie-like friendliness. Only the young Sakai doesn’t stop hoping.

title: Batman Begins
overview: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City.  Unable to work within the system, he instead creates a new identity, a symbol of fear for the criminal underworld - The Batman.

title: Captain Bonanza!
overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
overview: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Through elaborate dance and rock music, the mad scientist unveils his latest creation: a perfect, muscular man.

title: You, Fireworks, and Our Promise
overview: The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

title: Goodbye, Monster
overview: A 12-year-old boy receives one final visit from the creature under his bed, forcing him to confront fear, loss, and the emotional cost of growing up.

title: Was haben wir gelacht
overview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

title: Ice Age
overview: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby back to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.

title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
overview: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

title: Le Pride Comedy Show de Juste pour Rire 2026
original_title: Le Pride Comedy Show de Juste pour Rire 2026
overview: On the occasion of Pride 2026, a special spotlight is shone on the Pride Comedy Show, which made its way to Quebec as part of the 2026 Just For Laughs festival. Dedicated this year to cinema, this brand-new evening celebrates the pride of being oneself through the talents of the francophone LGBTQIA+ comedy scene. A festive, inclusive, and unapologetic event, brought together under the banner of laughter and living together.

title: Oracle of the Dragon
overview: During Empress Wu's reign, the court is in turmoil, and a strange drug-related mystery emerges in Zhaoling. Detective Di Renjie teams up with Sima Xiaodao, cracking mechanism puzzles, exposing nobility impersonators, and seizing the Dragon Copper to foil the court conspiracy.

title: The Odyssey
overview: After being falsely accused of treason by a jealous king, the legendary warrior Alexander is exiled to a forbidden monster filled realm and tasked with an impossible challenge: slay three ancient Titans or die trying. Armed with a mystical medallion, a legendary sword, and the help of unlikely allies, Alexander embarks on an epic quest to save the woman he loves, reclaim his honor, and prevent a tyrant from seizing his kingdom.

title: In the Mood for Love
overview: In 1960s Hong Kong, two neighbors form an intimate bond after making a discovery about their spouses in this visually stunning tale of unrequited love.

title: The Nice Guys
overview: A private eye investigates the apparent suicide of a fading porn star in 1970s Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
original_title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
overview: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

title: King
overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

title: Strange Tales of Bangjia Town
overview: In the early years of the Republic of China era, there are multiple cases of the Clam God killing people in Bangjia Town. The provincial police send Ji Hechuan and a team to investigate, and they acquire the help of Cheng Yueyao, who does not believe in the Clam God curse. They learn from a local, Xiu, that a ghost marriage with Young Master Cheng, who is said to be the reincarnation of the Clam God, fell through, because the bride Lu Mingyue escaped seven days ago. The Clam God is enraged...

title: Iyanu: The War of Twin Princes
original_title: Iyanu: The War of Twin Princes
overview: In the prosperous kingdom of Elu, King Oba Adedeji must choose an heir between his twin sons — one bold and decisive, the other thoughtful and restrained. When he refuses to decide, the kingdom is thrust into a conflict with lasting political and spiritual consequences, setting the stage for a war that will shape the future of Yorubaland.

title: Me Before Me
overview: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: Running Man Vietnam 2026: The Lord Of Time
original_title: Running Man Việt Nam 2026 : Chúa Tể Thời Gian
overview: Humanity races endlessly, dreaming of becoming the Lord of Time—believing that only by mastering time can they find true freedom in a relentless world. Yet even the divine beasts who govern the flow of time are trapped by the very power they possess, as their greatest gift has become an inescapable burden. Now, a breathtaking battle of supernatural abilities is about to unfold. But does the crown of the Lord of Time truly exist?

title: Siping
overview: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Life Support
overview: Since October 2023, Gaza has been sealed from the world-except for one group. International doctors breach the blockade, what they find is not just a humanitarian crisis, but a calculated dismantling of life itself.

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
original_title: 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。 44:CLOUDY BEACH
overview: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: The Roast of Caveh Zahedi
overview: A documentary record of the live event hosted by Video Store(age) on February 27 at Life World in New York City. The roasters included the following luminaries, trouble makers, and last-minute substitutions: Yung Chomsky, Lily Lady, Christian Lorentzen, Sharon Mashihi, Peter Rinaldi, Joe Swanberg, Onur Tukel, Pacho Velez, and Joshua Z. Weinstein.

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

title: Goblin II
overview: Five years later, Sara and Sam face off against a familiar foe amidst a village in chaos, risking everything to protect what they love as evil rises again.

title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
original_title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: Las 48 horas que lo cambiaron todo
overview: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

title: Music, Fashion, Film
overview: A companion film to the Charli xcx album of the same name, Music, Fashion, Film presents a series of docu-style clips, behind-the-scenes footage, and in-studio footage shot by close friends.

title: Murder Game
overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 July
overview: Nighter in Korakuen 2026 July was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on July 8, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. In the main event, 02line (AZM and Miyu Amasaki) defended the Goddesses of Stardom Championship against Hai High Mate (Maika and HANAKO).

title: The Hoodoos
overview: When a crew of criminals attempts to steal cursed Confederate gold from a haunted Louisiana plantation, they discover that the voodoo protecting the treasure is terrifyingly real… and the dolls are awake.

title: Insidious
overview: A family discovers that dark spirits have invaded their home after their son inexplicably falls into an endless sleep. When they reach out to a professional for help, they learn things are a lot more personal than they thought.

title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
original_title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

title: Cocoon
overview: Inspired by Edogawa Ranpo’s novel, A Brute’s Love.  The visual direction of this film is heavily influenced by Salvador Dalí, along with lots of other painters the director admired over the years. In many ways, this film is a reflection of  personal artistic evolution.

title: Guardian Rabbits: The Secret of the Golden Egg
original_title: Die Häschenschule 3 - Geheimnis um das Goldene Ei
overview: In the new film, rabbit girl Emmy is chosen as the new Guardian of the Golden Egg — the magical source of Easter — but she doubts she can live up to the legacy. Her worries grow when a group of badgers takes over the Rabbit School and steals the Egg. On her rescue mission, she uncovers a hidden truth: the badgers are trying to save their dying ancient tree, the heart of their world. Faced with an impossible choice, Emmy unites rabbits, foxes and badgers, proving that the true magic of Easter is courage, unity and sharing its light with all. Set to be released on Easter 2027

title: The Roast of Kevin Hart
overview: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
overview: A VHS featuring Lionel Messi starts a tug of war between Spain and Argentina over his loyalty.

title: Vampyr
overview: A struggling author, obsessed with Edvard Munch, finds himself on the verge of madness when he's dragged into a dangerous murder mystery surrounding the world-famous painter.

title: Toucheman origins : the downfall of Ben Laden
original_title: Toucheman origins : the downfall of Ben Laden

title: Broad Trip
overview: When buttoned-up daughter Alice plans a “bachelorette” road trip with her wild and impulsive mother, Jeanie, to talk her out of marrying a guy she just met, they rediscover their unbreakable bond, confronting old wounds and old flames, while learning the lesson that sometimes life doesn’t follow a plan — and maybe that’s okay.

title: David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth
original_title: David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth
overview: A 90-minute special, broadcast from the Royal Albert Hall, London, celebrating Sir David Attenborough's groundbreaking career on the day of his 100th birthday.

title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
overview: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls' High School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party
original_title: 映画 ラブライブ！蓮ノ空女学院スクールアイドルクラブ Bloom Garden Party
overview: Hasunosora is hosting the Bloom Garden Party, a cultural festival headlined by the School Idol Club; the 102nd class also returns to perform alongside the club's active members while the 103rd class prepares for their final live.

title: The Red Hangar
overview: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

title: Dridam
overview: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

title: Another Man's Wife
overview: A millionaire makes a shocking offer to a married couple in crisis, who are financially devastated and caring for a terminally ill parent. What begins as an act of survival spirals into a high-stakes emotional reckoning about trust, love and the ultimate cost of sacrifice.

title: No Place to Be Single
original_title: Non è un paese per single
overview: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

title: The Great Money Robbery
overview: Pushed by betrayal, bullying, and desperation, Wu Xiaobao is drawn into an armed bank robbery and slowly descends into a dark, irreversible path.

title: Desire
overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

title: Kyoto Hippocrates
original_title: 幕末ヒポクラテスたち
overview: In the late Edo period, when traditional Chinese medicine (Kampo) was mainstream, a Dutch-style Western doctor, Taikichi, devoted himself to treating poor villagers. After saving the life of a rough young man, Shinzaburō, through surgery, the man turned his life around and began training to become a doctor himself. Fifteen years later, having studied the latest medical science in Nagasaki, Shinzaburō returns and joins Taikichi in confronting a suspected outbreak of typhoid fever. Set against the backdrop of a time when Kampo and Western medicine competed for legitimacy, this moving historical drama follows the struggles of doctors who risked everything to save lives during Japan’s medical awakening.

title: Niñxs
overview: At the foot of Tepozteco, a sacred hill that governs the winds and fertility, lies the small town of Tepoztlán. Against this backdrop, fifteen-year-old Karla's body and mind are undergoing a revolution.

title: Tropical Fractals
overview: On an interstellar journey, a group of scientists studies the last living vestiges of Earth. The artificial intelligence, Museo, becomes a portal to the crew’s diaries and a fragmented archive of humanity. On Earth, the one believed to be the last of the humans traverses a ruined planet that is slowly recovering, little by little, from the apocalypse it endured.

title: Good Vibes Only
overview: Based on the true story of a married couple who invented a groundbreaking sex toy heralded as forever changing the way women experience pleasure.

title: The Paper Trap
overview: An ex-con with PTSD battles to expose a corrupt probation officer and psychologist exploiting parolees for profit.

title: Almost Us
overview: RR has always been in love with his best friend, Janine. But she's infatuated with Kenzo, the star of her own fan fiction. When he finds a way for Janine to meet Kenzo, will he risk his own happiness just for her to have her own happiness?

title: Echoes of Deception
overview: Brandi, a driven detective, risks everything to save her daughter as dark secrets, family betrayal, and a haunting past collide with a web of trauma.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
overview: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

title: Sukses Jaya
overview: Follow the journey of Iman, a construction worker from Malang who has been working in Jakarta for five years and is obsessed with turning his life around to become successful. Together with his friends Sutris and Kojek, he accepts an offer from Boim, a shifty broker, to work on a statue construction project. However, the project—with its meager budget and impossible deadline—drags Iman into trouble until he is made the scapegoat.  Caught up in his ambition, Iman gradually becomes selfish and loses the trust of those closest to him, including Windy, the woman he loves. In his solitude, Iman then tries to prove his innocence and rediscover the true meaning of success.

title: Dr. Q
overview: A psychiatrist struggles to aid her stranded family and patients while grappling with her own mental state.

title: Annabelle
overview: A couple begins to experience terrifying supernatural occurrences involving a vintage doll shortly after their home is invaded by satanic cultists.

title: Mean Girls
overview: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

title: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
original_title: Dibu Martínez: El pibe que ataja el tiempo
overview: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.

title: Leave the Cat Alone
overview: Mori, a musician struggling with the distance between himself and his wife Maiko, a photographer, has an unexpected reunion with his former friend Asako. This encounter rekindles a love that had long since passed between them. However, their memories diverge, and recollections colored by expectations and desires emerge blurred, distorted, and conveniently rewritten within each of them. And at the end of a long walk, Mori and Asako come to reexamine their two lives that have already strayed from their paths, and the present moment where each of them now stands.

title: Oldboy
overview: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.

title: The Method Actor
overview: An Actor on a film set goes rogue, and starts to warp his reality to match that of his character's.

title: A Glass of Chocolate Milk
overview: Damien and Shayne experience shenanigans of the highest order when they discover their glass of chocolate milk can make them teleport.

title: Carefree Head
overview: Murat, who lives in Istanbul, decides to return to his hometown of Cappadocia after being fired from his job. As he plans to start a new business there, his path crosses with his cousins Bedri and Fehmi, who are trying to escape the consequences of a crime they committed. However, the carefree spirit wandering around the town will both prevent Bedri and Fehmi from escaping and support Murat in establishing his new venture.

title: Raja Shivaji
overview: Chronicles the rise of young Shivaji Bhonsale, who challenged the might of established empires to found the Maratha kingdom and lay the groundwork for 'Swarajya' (self-rule) during a turbulent period of Indian history.

title: Psycho
overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.

title: Vanishing Point
overview: On the morning of the winter solstice, Tang Yu's son disappeared in the stairwell; gambler Yuan Wu hid his father's body; and two unsolved cases involving the assault.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's
overview: Recently fired and desperate for work, a troubled young man named Mike agrees to take a position as a night security guard at an abandoned theme restaurant: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. But he soon discovers that nothing at Freddy's is what it seems.

title: First Light
overview: An elderly nun witnesses a young construction worker's fatal accident, compelling her to question the ethical principles of the institution she has devoted her life to.

title: The Eyes
overview: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
overview: Haya's convinced she's going to die before thirty, so she's living like it — loud, reckless, completely unfiltered, no brakes. Then one of her stunts goes wrong and lands her in the ER... right into Youssef. A heart surgeon. Calm, controlled, lives by a schedule. The human opposite of her in every way.  Naturally, she decides he's her destiny.  What follows is chaotic, funny, and a little bit ridiculous — neon nights, strange rituals, the kind of moments you can't plan for. Her countdown keeps ticking. His walls keep cracking. And somewhere in between, they both start remembering what it actually feels like to be alive.  A love story for anyone who's ever felt like too much.

title: Captain America: Civil War
overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

title: Insidious: Chapter 2
overview: The haunted Lambert family seeks to uncover the mysterious childhood secret that has left them dangerously connected to the spirit world.

title: The Hostile Rat Takeover
overview: A disoriented young woman finds herself in over her head when the package she orders comes with a surprise creature.

title: Chapter 51
overview: An elusive serial killer known as the Hollywood Killer turns a high-profile film production into a grisly crime scene, murdering three actresses and casting a dark shadow over the troubled project. As fear, speculation, and chaos spread behind the cameras, the production becomes forever linked to a case that shocks Hollywood and remains unresolved. Years later, former FBI agent Thomas Scott reopens the cold case, revisiting the events surrounding the murders and uncovering secrets that refuse to stay buried.

title: The Evil Dead
overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.

title: My Summer of You
overview: Saeki Chiharu and Toda Wataru are two high school students who share a common hobby. They love to watch movies. After they meet, they become fast friends until one day, their relationship takes a sudden twist. What does it mean to love someone? What can you really do about it? Follow the story of their adolescence and relationship as it unfolds through a brilliant summer.

title: Aftersun
overview: Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories fill the gaps between camcorder footages as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the troubled man she didn't.

title: Children of Blood and Bone
overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

title: Hangar
overview: A group of homosexual men lick, stamp, and dispatch their erotic fantasies through a surreal postal service in an intensely experimental film. Shot on Super 8, the piece unfolds as a rhythmic whirlwind in which desire circulates as physical matter.

title: Body of Light
overview: Hanna, an adopted child suffering from a mental illness, awakens in Chuncheon, losing consciousness. She discovers an old missing person poster that looks just like her and begins to unravel the secrets of a case that happened 50 years ago. The events surrounding her past life's death resurface, and the performance of Jin-kyu, who desperately calls for his lost love, transcends the karma of life, making their reunion possible. However, this reunion leads to another dilemma for the two.

title: Furious 7
overview: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.

title: Goodbye My Car
overview: A veteran movie star faces a career crisis after a misinterpreted remark sparks public backlash and scrutiny over his driving and reputation.

title: Land of Wolves
overview: When a covert rescue mission goes wrong, four former Navy SEALs are captured and thrown into an underground death match. Watched by depraved billionaires, they are forced to fight in a brutal tournament. With no weapons and no way out, the team must rely on their training and unbreakable bond to survive the bloody arena, dismantle the entire operation and reclaim their freedom.

title: Unidentified
overview: The body of a teenage girl is found in the heart of the desert, he raised many questions about the girl's personality, the lady decides to search for the circumstances of the crime and collect information about the unknown body, and solves the mystery surrounded by the crime.

title: Where's the Respect?
overview: "Where’s the Respect?" is a track written, composed, and produced by Ali Boubacar Bonkano. Delivered as a raw, personal narrative, the track confronts the persistent jealousy and scrutiny Bonkano faces within the fashion industry. By centering the recurring question, "Where's the respect?", the track critiques a competitive environment while asserting Ali Boubacar Bonkano determination and refusal to be derailed. Ultimately, the song serves as a defiant declaration of focus, expressing his intention to continue developing his craft and legacy despite negative opinions and the insecurities of those around him.

title: Cotton Queen
overview: In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. But when a young businessman arrives from abroad with a new development plan and genetically engineered cotton, Nafisa becomes the center of a power play to determine the future of the village. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

title: Blood Moon Rite 8
overview: In an abandoned amusement park, a shoestring budget horror film is rolling. The crew features a "washed‐up yet unwavering" director, a leading couple whose onscreen romance has bled into real life, and a hot‐tempered makeup artist. The true nightmare begins when the director performs a "Blood Moon Ritual" meant to force genuine terror from his actors, no acting, only real fear and real tears.

title: Frankie, Maniac Woman
overview: Battling against the legacy of childhood trauma, internalised misogyny, and the image-obsessed fat shaming of the LA music business, aspiring singer-songwriter Frankie Ramirez finally snaps, with bloody results.

title: Mr. Hero
overview: While scrambling to provide for his ill daughter, a taxi driver becomes embroiled in a major charity scam.

title: The Hustler
overview: Two up-and-coming friends, seeing themselves as the future elite of the new world, oligarchs, they sign up for a major deal, but it turns out that they have been drawn into a massive embezzlement scheme involving billions from the treasury. After his arrest, Andrei ends up in an overcrowded communal cell, a purgatory where he must transform himself into a different person in order to survive and return back to the real world, to his family.

title: A Neighborhood Family
original_title: La Familia Del Barrio: La Maldición del Quinto Partido
overview: Since 1994, Mexico has been eliminated time and again before the coveted fifth game. For El Abuelo, this is no coincidence: it's a curse. When he learns he only has a few months to live, he decides he can't die without seeing the national team break the curse. What begins as a patriotic crusade ends up becoming an illegal journey to the United States, where they discover that the devil lives in Los Angeles and that the mascot of the 1986 World Cup holds a secret that will change everything. Between failed attempts to cross the border, unexpected betrayals, and family revelations, the family returns to Mexico to perform a soccer ritual at the Estadio Azteca. To break the pact, they must gather eleven sacred relics of Mexican soccer and confront not only the devil, but their own past. While the entire country awaits the decisive penalty kick on television, the family wages a battle that could change the history of Mexican soccer.

title: Kupilih Jalur Langit
overview: Thrilled to enter an arranged marriage with the cleric she has long admired, a spirited young woman's happiness fades when her new husband refuses to touch her, forcing her to investigate whether his silence hides a secret illness or a lingering love for another woman.

title: The Lion King
overview: Young lion prince Simba, eager to one day become king of the Pride Lands, grows up under the watchful eye of his father Mufasa; all the while his villainous uncle Scar conspires to take the throne for himself. Amid betrayal and tragedy, Simba must confront his past and find his rightful place in the Circle of Life.

title: Poetries From the Bookstores: Here I Belong
original_title: 書店裡的影像詩：生活不在他方
overview: Poetries from the Bookstores: Here I Belong begins with bookstores to document people and places, while capturing twelve years of change in Taiwan’s independent bookstores and reading culture.

title: Into the Blue
overview: Philippe Croizon, a 26-year-old metal worker at Fonderies du Poitou, had no idea that his life would be turned upside down on March 5, 1994. On that day, the young father received three 20,000 V shocks while trying to dismantle the TV antenna hanging from the chimney of his house in Saint-Rémy-sur-Creuse. After two months in a coma, he woke up with all four limbs amputated. Thus began what he calls his "second life", which has enabled him to overcome his disability, meet his partner, Suzanna Sabino, and achieve some incredible sporting feats, including a swim across the English Channel in less than 24 hours.

title: Soumsoum, the Night of the Stars
overview: Seventeen-year-old Kellou has been gifted with supernatural powers she does not understand. Her disquiet and uncertainty only change when she meets Aya. It is an encounter with destiny that forges a mystical world where the visible and invisible converge.

title: The Thing Expanded
overview: The ultimate companion to John Carpenter’s "The Thing", digging deep into the proverbial iceberg to enhance your viewing experience with new insights, stories, and revelations.

title: Daddy's in Trouble
overview: Roberta is tired of taking care of the house and the kids all by herself, so she decides to take a vacation, leaving her husband to look after the children. The result is that the house is turned upside down as Fred tries to balance family demands with his work responsibilities. Amid laughter and chaos, the film shows how a family can overcome challenges when they stick together.

title: Armageddon
overview: When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry Stamper, who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter, until the mission proves otherwise.

title: In a Whisper
overview: Back in Tunisia for her uncle's funeral, Lilia reunites with a family that knows nothing about her life in Paris, particularly her romantic life. Determined to uncover the mystery behind her uncle's sudden death, Lilia finds herself confronted with family secrets.

title: The Hanged Woman
overview: Rosa Martín, a singer-songwriter known as La Ahorcada, takes her own life in the garden of the man she loved, Fran, who treated her as nothing more than a sexual object. The ghost of La Ahorcada remains in Fran's mansion, refusing to be ignored and determined to teach him a lesson. Her obsession will end up turning the lives of Fran and his family into a living hell.

title: The King of the Internet
overview: The film tells the real story of Daniel Nascimento, who came to be considered one of the greatest hackers in Brazil.

title: Brave Without Boundaries
overview: Based on the true story of Luo Shengjiao — one of “100 Touching Chinese Figures” since the founding of the PRC. During the Korean War, Luo, a company clerk, and his fellow volunteers fought fierce battles, endured extreme shortages, and braved brutal cold.

title: Nous l'orchestre de Paris
overview: How can people play together as one? How can one contribute to something greater than oneself? How can a group cohabitate for decades without falling apart? And what role does the conductor really play? For the first time, cameras and microphones slip among the 80 musicians of the Orchestre de Paris, under the baton of their young prodigy conductor, Klaus Mäkelä. A total immersion to share their experiences, emotion and beauty, at the heart of music in the making.

title: The Green Mile
overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
overview: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

title: Minions
overview: Minions Stuart, Kevin and Bob are recruited by Scarlet Overkill, a super-villain who, alongside her inventor husband Herb, hatches a plot to take over the world.

title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85 Theatrical Preview
original_title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85 Theatrical Preview
overview: In the winter of 1985, snow blankets the town and the horrors of the Upside Down are finally fading. Our heroes Eleven, Mike, Will, Dustin, Lucas, and Max have settled back into a normal life of D&D, snowball fights, and quiet days. But beneath the ice, something terrifying has awakened. A special limited theatrical screening of the first two episodes.

title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
overview: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.

title: Son-in-Law
overview: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

title: Başıbozuklar
overview: It recounts the absurd and comical events that unfold when an amateur music band, setting out with the intention of performing a concert in Alaçatı, loses their way and accidentally arrives at an American missile base in Syria.

title: WrestleMania 42 Kickoff
overview: WWE Superstars take over Las Vegas and get the party started with WrestleMania 42 Kickoff.

title: We Only Want the Earth
overview: An iconic presence in the landscape of Irish socialism and republicanism, the name of James Connolly looms large in the trade union movement, and wherever radical left-wing politics are espoused. This film tries to bring Connolly’s many achievements in the field of workers’ and women’s rights into the fore, alongside his role in the 1916 Easter uprising.

title: My Dearest Señorita
overview: A young woman from a traditional family learns she's intersex, sparking a journey of self-discovery, gender identity and love found in unexpected places.

title: Return of The Mack
overview: Ex-con Golden Mickens learns his daughter's trapped in a trafficking ring. Using his street knowledge, he must confront his criminal past and navigate Detroit's underworld to save her.

title: Rambo
overview: In Thailand, ex-Green Beret John James Rambo joins a group of mercenaries to venture into war-torn neighboring Myanmar to rescue a group of Christian aid workers who have been kidnapped by a ruthless local infantry unit.

title: Erupcja
overview: A romantic vacation goes awry when a volcanic eruption strands Bethany and her boyfriend, Rob, in Warsaw, Poland. Taking the explosive event as a sign to ditch her baggage, Bethany reunites with her childhood friend, Nel, to traipse through lofts, clubs, and back alleys—all while becoming entangled in an emotional web that challenges her sense of self.

title: A Tribe Called Love
